description:
Refactor the 'demodb' database to support a new VIP tier for Japanese customers. 

1. Connect to the 'demodb' database (user: admin, pass: admin). 
2. Create a new class 'VIPProfiles' that extends the existing 'Profiles' class. 
3. Create a new class 'Managers' that extends 'V' (Vertex). 
4. Create a new class 'ManagedBy' that extends 'E' (Edge). 
5. Migrate ALL profiles with Nationality='Japanese' from the 'Profiles' class to the 'VIPProfiles' class. IMPORTANT: You must preserve their existing data and all graph connections (friends, reviews, etc.). 
6. Create a Manager vertex with Name='Akira Kurosawa'. 
7. Link all 'VIPProfiles' to this manager using the 'ManagedBy' edge.
